trade-sell.title: Stored goods sold where a station bid stands: each ship sells its own stores, nothing bought
trade-sell.note: Every route is gated by requires.stored (the pilot's own storage) and requires.bid (a book read within the hour at the floor); a run sells only what the bid takes. Open to every division's ships (rule F24). Starter hull, no module needed.

trade-craft.title: Goods made by hand for sale where a bid pays more than the inputs
trade-craft.note: Inputs from the pilot's own storage at the workshop's station, at most one bought unit a run; the made good is sold into the bid named by requires.bid. A test until its first RESULT line.

trade-train-nav.title: Navigation trained to 3 on a loop of our five stations, for Signal Fragments (7,000 cr once)
trade-train-nav.note: requires.skills_below navigation 3: the route closes by itself at navigation 3, and Signal Fragments in the list First takes the pilot. About 4 navigation XP a jump, a loop of 17 to 18 minutes for about 165 cr of fuel.

trade-gas.title: Gas harvested and sold into the Node Beta and Central Nexus gas bids
trade-gas.note: Needs a Gas Harvester I. One ship a route: the hydrogen and plasma bids take a few dozen units an hour; the loss stop closes a route whose last runs lost.
